codeReview.summary: The commit correctly rewrites io.fork_tales labels to io.eta_mu across the reviewed files and renames docker-compose.muse-song-lab.yml, but it leaves one stale narrative/discovery hint in the root compose file, so the feature is not fully complete.

issues.description: `DOCKER_SIMULATION_NAME_HINTS` still contains `muse-song` even though the feature renamed the experiment stack to `agent-song-lab`. This leaves a narrative residue in a Docker-related config file and overrides `docker_runtime.py`'s current default hint list (`agent-song` at lines 101-107), reintroducing the old name into runtime discovery config.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `.factory/services.yaml` does not include any docker-compose validation commands even though the config-integration milestone requires compose syntax verification. The worker had to invent the compose checks manually.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/services.yaml:1-13` lists frontend/python validators only; transcript skeleton shows ad hoc commands `docker compose config --quiet` and `docker compose -f ... config --quiet` for this feature.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The refactor-worker skill has no guidance for safely proving a config validation failure is pre-existing, and the worker resorted to `git stash && ... && git stash pop` on a dirty tree to compare `docker-compose.local-llm.yml` behavior.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `refactor-worker/SKILL.md` has no procedure for pre-existing-validator triage; transcript skeleton includes `cd /home/shuv/repos/fork_tales && git stash && cd part64 && docker compose -f docker-compose.local-llm.yml config --quiet 2>&1; cd /home/shuv/repos/fork_tales && git stash pop`.
